exceptions.statement: New-device comparison approval and scope upgrade stay local-only.
Native OS folder picker stays server-local; remote uses the M37 directory browser.
Remote Start of a fully stopped gateway remains unsupported until M23/M24.
Newly typed provider keys may be submitted transiently; existing keys are never returned.
Folder-browser roots default to empty pending explicit server configuration.
Logs/export diagnostics and native folder picking are desktop-host capabilities.
